ABI and event definitions for QUIC shared-memory logging.

# Purpose
Defines the ABI and record layout for QUIC shared-memory logging. The `fd_quic_log_abi_t` structure stores the values needed to read log messages from a `quic_log` interface, including the `FD_QUIC_LOG_MAGIC` value and cache offsets. The `fd_quic_log_hdr_t` and `fd_quic_log_error_t` structures define the fixed fields for log records, such as connection ID, packet number, source address, UDP source port, encryption level, flags, error codes, source file, and source line. The event ID macros classify log events for connection state changes and object pool allocation failures, so code can emit and consume consistent QUIC log messages.
